Prob035_count1to10.code:
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    output reg [3:0] q
);

    // Synchronous active-high reset decade counter (1 to 10)
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 4'd1;          // reset to 1
        end else begin
            if (q == 4'd10) begin
                q <= 4'd1;      // wrap from 10 to 1
            end else begin
                q <= q + 1'b1;  // increment otherwise
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

Prob056_ece241_2013_q7.code:
module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input j,
    input k,
    output reg Q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        case ({j, k})
            2'b00: Q <= Q;        // Hold state
            2'b01: Q <= 1'b0;     // Reset
            2'b10: Q <= 1'b1;     // Set
            2'b11: Q <= ~Q;       // Toggle
        endcase
    end

endmodule

Prob076_always_case.code:
module TopModule (
    input  [2:0] sel,
    input  [3:0] data0,
    input  [3:0] data1,
    input  [3:0] data2,
    input  [3:0] data3,
    input  [3:0] data4,
    input  [3:0] data5,
    output [3:0] out
);

    // 6-to-1 multiplexer: select data0 to data5 when sel is 0 to 5, else output 0
    assign out = (sel == 3'd0) ? data0 :
                 (sel == 3'd1) ? data1 :
                 (sel == 3'd2) ? data2 :
                 (sel == 3'd3) ? data3 :
                 (sel == 3'd4) ? data4 :
                 (sel == 3'd5) ? data5 :
                                 4'b0000;

endmodule

Prob079_fsm3onehot.code:
module TopModule (
    input in,
    input [3:0] state,
    output [3:0] next_state,
    output out
);

    // Next state logic (one-hot encoding)
    assign next_state[0] = (state[0] & ~in) | (state[2] & ~in); // A_next
    assign next_state[1] = (state[0] & in)  | (state[1] & in)  | (state[3] & in); // B_next
    assign next_state[2] = (state[1] & ~in) | (state[3] & ~in); // C_next
    assign next_state[3] = (state[2] & in); // D_next

    // Output logic (Moore machine: output depends only on current state)
    assign out = state[3]; // High only in state D

endmodule

Prob115_shift18.code:
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  load,
    input  ena,
    input  [1:0] amount,
    input  [63:0] data,
    output reg [63:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            q <= data;
        end else if (ena) begin
            case (amount)
                2'b00: q <= {q[62:0], 1'b0};                    // left shift by 1
                2'b01: q <= {q[55:0], 8'b0};                    // left shift by 8
                2'b10: q <= {{8{q[63]}}, q[63:8]};              // arithmetic right shift by 1
                2'b11: q <= {{56{q[63]}}, q[63:8]};             // arithmetic right shift by 8
                default: q <= q;                                // default case (should not occur)
            endcase
        end
        // If neither load nor ena is active, q retains its value (no assignment needed)
    end

endmodule

Prob100_fsm3comb.code:
module TopModule (
    input in,
    input [1:0] state,
    output reg [1:0] next_state,
    output reg out
);
    always_comb begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin // State A
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; // in=1 -> B, in=0 -> A
                out = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b01: begin // State B
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; // in=1 -> B, in=0 -> C
                out = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b10: begin // State C
                next_state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b00; // in=1 -> D, in=0 -> A
                out = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b11: begin // State D
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; // in=1 -> B, in=0 -> C
                out = 1'b1;
            end
            default: begin // Default case for safety (should not occur with 2-bit state)
                next_state = 2'b00;
                out = 1'b0;
            end
        endcase
    end
endmodule

Prob124_rule110.code:
module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input load,
    input [511:0] data,
    output reg [511:0] q
);
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            q <= data;
        end else begin
            q[0] <= (q[0] & ~q[1]) | (~q[0] & q[1]);
            q[511] <= (q[510] & ~q[511]) | (~q[510] & q[511]);
            for (genvar i = 1; i < 511; i = i + 1) begin
                q[i] <= (q[i-1] & ~q[i] & ~q[i+1]) |
                        (~q[i-1] & q[i] & ~q[i+1]) |
                        (~q[i-1] & ~q[i] & q[i+1]) |
                        (q[i-1] & q[i] & ~q[i+1]);
            end
        end
    end
endmodule
